keyFindings.description: The round-2 guard (line 522) keeps a NUL path away from the asset store, but a path that is not valid UTF-8 still reaches it. For example, GET /assets/%ff.js: os.Stat answers ENOENT, then dashboard.Store.GetAsset fails with SQLSTATE 22021 'invalid byte sequence for encoding UTF8: 0xff'. That error is not ErrAssetNotFound, so anyone, signed in or not, gets a 502 and an ERROR line 'dispatch: retained asset store failed' for a name no build can hold. Reproduced on real Postgres 17 with a throwaway test of GetAsset("assets/\xff.js") (removed afterwards). Fix: answer a key that cannot be a Postgres text value (a NUL byte or invalid UTF-8) as a miss, plus a test row.
The comment at line 1049 still says run-server.sh builds the server 'inside Playwright's 60 s wait'. Since main's #2229, e2e/harness-start.ts waits, bounded by listener.bootMs.
